# Investigate
## When to use
Repository orientation or a question.
## Required context
The relevant entry point.
## Preconditions
No implementation is requested.
## Procedure
Follow one trace, inspect sources, distinguish observations from inferences.
Activate `context-discovery` for broad orientation.
## Tools
Read-only search and inspection.
## Rules
Do not fill unknowns with guesses.
## Verification
Cross-check important claims.
## Evidence
Source paths and limitations.
## Completion criteria
The question has a grounded answer.
## Failure modes
Missing source: report uncertainty.
## References
[Exploration scope](references/playbook.md).


## Paved integration

Use the project-local Paved contract as the source of truth. Discover state with `node "<plugin root>/scripts/paved.mjs" status --json`, load only relevant `.paved/project/` context, and invoke verification with `node "<plugin root>/scripts/paved.mjs" verify --json`. `<plugin root>` is the installed Paved plugin directory, two directories above this SKILL.md. Always run the launcher from the repository being worked on, never from the plugin directory. Do not edit generated integration files or bypass Paved lifecycle and ownership checks.
